messages:
incidents-bot: Paging: HIGH_ERROR_RATE on /v1/embeddings (route=embeddings-hot). Severity: P2. Alerting on 5xx spike + sustained tail latency.
pranav (oncall): I’m on it. seeing 5xxs from the embeddings infra pool, rate limited errors up ~18% last 5m. Customers A,B,C show elevated errors.
jamie (sre): adding context — memory pressure + KV cache misses on the shards serving embeddings-hot. Chat routes look OK.
sasha (infra): I can try a soft-eviction of cold KV shards and nudge autoscaler to add 2 instances, but that will take ~3-4m. Meanwhile recommend traffic shaping.
pranav (oncall): Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) reduce per-endpoint quota for embeddings-hot to 30 rps/customer; 2) route-carve: move lower-tier embeddings traffic to embeddings-warm; 3) disable rerank on low-priority paths that cascade into embeddings.
eve (support): Notifying tier-1 customers who might see degraded embeddings. Sending canned note to A,B,C.
pranav (oncall): Executing changes now. Commands:```sh
# lower per-customer qps for embeddings-hot
rbctl quota set --route=embeddings-hot --per-customer-qps=30
# apply route carve for anon tier
rbctl route move --from=embeddings-hot --to=embeddings-warm --selector="tier:free" --percent=60
# disable rerank fallback path
rbctl feature toggle --service=rerank --scope=non-critical --state=off
```
jamie (sre): Applying rate limits. Watch the 5xx graph: https://redwood.internal/metrics/route/embeddings-hot (dashboards > embeddings).
sasha (infra): Autoscaler request submitted: +2 gpus to embeddings-hot pool, ETA 4m. Doing soft-evict now (will rebalance caches):```sh
rbops evict --pool=embeddings-hot --policy=soft --pct=15
```
pranav (oncall): Early signal: 5xxs down from 18% -> 9% in 2m after quota reduce and route-carve. Latency tail still high for long inputs.
eve (support): Customer A confirms partial success, still some timeouts for long docs. Escalated to Product for retries guidance.
jamie (sre): Next step if errors persist: tighten burst window from 10s -> 3s and enable tiered backpressure on embeddings-warm. Will coordinate with pruners.
ops-rotation: Handoff: I’m taking over after 15m. pranav, leave notes about actions and tickets.
pranav (oncall): Notes: actions taken: quota reduced, route carve ~60% for free tier, rerank disabled for non-critical, autoscale +2 requested, soft-evict done. Current status: errors down but not fully healed. Customers impacted: A,B,C (partial). Follow-up: collect KV miss rates, memory pressure logs, and evaluate compacting model shards during next maintenance window.
jamie (sre): Filing incident-triage ticket: INC-20260316-embeddings-hot. Assigning to eng-ml + infra for root cause.
eve (support): Sent update to affected customers: short mitigation in place, working on full fix.
ops-rotation: Acknowledged handoff. Oncall steps documented in thread. If 5xx > 10% again revert rerank-toggle to on for critical customers only.
pranav (oncall): Thanks — will follow up in ticket and attach charts + commands. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident P2 still open. Next update in 10m or on significant change.
